The May pin shows fake charts. The September pin does not pick the world. Do not cite V923 as if the pin were QRSL. Pin certifies after a world is supplied — it does not select the world.

May–June 2026 (Restricted harnesses)

Five-history 5/5 visible vs 1/5 pinned; V923 geometry-only 62.86%; V1152.5 counterfeits; BPI2014 (M≈0.875). Meaning: geometry cannot self-validate in these packages.

12 Sep 2026 (v13.23)

Pin is a ledger, not a selector. Same coarse SHA, two fine τ-lifts. QRSL search stopped. GitHub-only. No X field note.

Genesis Pin is a ledger, not a selector. v13.23: Genesis Pin → QRSL: NO. Same coarse descriptor can hide distinct fine worlds. Pin identity is not a canonical refinement law.

Layer 01 of the stack. Astra identities live on their own article. This page keeps V923, the five-history filter, BPI2014, the V1152.5 provenance stack, and the 16 Jun mouse toy. The 10–11 Jun it-from-bit freeze — bind + order required, projection still Open — lives on its own article. v13.23 (GitHub-only): Genesis Pin is a ledger, not a selector. QRSL does not factor through the pin.

Before charts are allocated, the V1698 script initializes a Genesis / provenance ledger and SHA-256-locks the configuration. The point is not cryptography-as-physics. The point is that later geometry-like closure is only counted as retained if the identity of sources, the support of the data, and the order of updates survive.

This isn’t just standard discrete atlas stitching. It’s an “it from bit, bind, and order” construction. Geometry-like closure only counts as retained when the Genesis/Provenance Ledger + source/support/order admissibility also survive.

Ordinary differential geometry already requires cocycles. Spradlin’s added claim is that cocycle/holonomy closure is not sufficient in this framework unless the retained provenance layer also validates source, support, and ordered recoverability. Nulls that shuffle source, order, or support while leaving transition matrices intact are supposed to fail.

Genesis Pin is a provenance ledger for retained geometry-like structure in the executable construction. It is a legitimacy filter on the ledger — not a world-selector, not an origin of time, and not a cosmological initial-condition theorem.

V923 — geometry admits the basin, information certifies the source

On 22 May 2026, a day before the five-history pin, the V923 branch measured why visible geometry is not enough. The conformal basin E_OSC was admissible — and source-degenerate. The same coordinates could be occupied by an actively recovered state, a basin-eligible nonactive state, or a rejected/broken state. Observable geometry alone scored 62.86%. The best binary source lift reached 91.67%. A ternary source-role primitive closed at 100%. A four-family label was over-complete. Targeted corruption of the ternary role (basin-eligible → rejected) dropped accuracy to 57.14% on 360 rows.

\mathcal{C}=(Q_{\mathrm{obs}},S_{\mathrm{ternary}}),\quad S\in\{S_{\mathrm{active}},S_{\mathrm{basin/nonactive}},S_{\mathrm{rejected/broken}}\}

Maybe the bridge was never “bits vs geometry.” Maybe it was always: geometry as admissible form, information as legitimacy of source.

On the tested V921/V923 rows, ternary source-role is the first exact closure of source legitimacy. Geometry-only and binary lifts fail. Not a spacetime theorem and not an Einstein derivation.

Same visible state is not the same history

On 23 May 2026 a five-history simulation made the gate runnable. V997 named it as the legitimacy layer on top of V923: five different paths — forked, replayed, self-defined origin, tampered chain — were built to the same visible final state. Checking the final geometry accepts all five. Requiring a Genesis Pin (pinned root registry, witness quorum, append-only recoverable provenance) lets only one pass.

Same visible state does not mean same legitimate history. Visible equivalence is not legitimacy.

Geometry cannot validate itself

The 1 Jun 2026 thread moved the same sentence onto real recovery traces. Scoring law M_total = C_topological × P_sequence × E_arrow: if sequence, provenance, or entropy direction fails, the geometry collapses. UCI 498 showed a strong pruning-order signal but missed holdout certification — not counted as a win. BPI2014, after restoring entropy-arrow and damage-before-repair, passed the full adversarial suite (true-trace M ≈ 0.875; 8/8 nulls failed).

M_{\mathrm{total}} = C_{\mathrm{topological}}\times P_{\mathrm{sequence}}\times E_{\mathrm{arrow}}

Geometry is not the proof. Geometry is the exhaust. The bit comes first. Then admissible history. Then retained structure. Then geometry.

Order-dependent recoverability traces on BPI2014 carry geometry-like closure that adversarial spatial counterfeits fail when sequence, provenance, entropy arrow, and phase order are jointly enforced. Not a GR, ADM, or curvature derivation. UCI 498 remains a near-miss.

If a mathematically flawless geometric structure is instantly vaporized by the universe's firewall simply because it lacks an auditable history, then structural perfection is meaningless without provenance.

Same-thread 2/ explainer (video on X) and Einstein 7 / v1472 package: geometry treated as a compressed receipt of discrete informational events. Multiplicative scoring zeros a provenance failure. Restricted operational claim — not GR.

V1152.5 — certified history, not shape

On 28 May 2026 the V1152.5 run made the same point as an executable stack, three days before BPI2014. Counterfeit histories imitated Ω similarity and some closure metrics but failed full certification. Only provenance plus ordered flow closure survived. Genesis Pin alone, Ω geometry alone, and closure alone were each insufficient. 29 May follow-up: code included, run it yourself.

In the posted V1152.5 controls, geometry-matched, source-shuffled, retained-order-shuffled, and raw C-only counterfeits failed full certification; valid noisy holdouts passed. Geometry similarity can be faked; provenance plus ordered flow closure could not, in this stack. Not GR.

Grok on the Genesis Key

The Retained Bridge captures the luminous boundary exactly. No full holographic dictionary needed—only the Genesis Pin anchoring certifiable history to admissible form. That minimal external anchor turns philosophical origin questions into recoverable legitimacy, with provenance as the path.

Mouse sim (16 Jun)

A pruning-network toy posted as an it-from-bit illustration. The drawn path is the illusion; underneath, a weight matrix prunes until the mouse runs out of network. 2/ lists six exact isomorphisms in the code. Restricted toy. Not GR, not a cosmological derivation.

Arrow of time: irreversible deletion of the weight matrix — recoverability lost one way.
Emergent space: renderer x,y,z is a lie; distance is BFS hop-count on the adjacency list.
Horizons: pathfinding returns empty; the destination still exists in the array, the path does not.
Expansion: stress penalizes length; long-range links snap first; local islands remain.
Nucleation: sub-critical damage heals; past a critical radius an ignition front consumes the network.
It from bit: ground exists iff a float stays above a threshold; below it, the bridge is gone.

Posted mouse is a runnable illustration of pruning-as-time and connectivity-as-space. Exact in the code. Not a derivation of physical spacetime or gravity.
